name: Error Prone Check

on:
  push:
    branches: ['master']
  pull_request:
    branches: ['master']

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v3
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven
      - name: Build with Maven
        run: mvn -P error-prone-check clean compile --file pom.xml
